SECTION C: Short Answer Type Questions (3 Marks Each)

Q29. “Banks play an important role in the economy of India.” Explain the statement with 
three suitable arguments.

Answer / Solution:
“Banks play an important role in the economy of India.” Explain the statement with 
three suitable arguments. 
1. Intermediary: Banks mediate between depositors (surplus funds) and borrowers 
(need funds). 
2. Credit Creation: They provide loans for economic activities, boosting production. 
3. Safety: They provide a safe place for savings and pay interest.
